short_description: Departure gate B12, used for short and medium haul flights.
directions: From main check-in hall, follow signs to Pier B, take escalator to Level 2, gate is on the left after security.
accessibility: Step-free access, wheelchair ramp available, accessible seating near gate desk.
related_facilities: Restroom Block A, Vending machines, Gate B10-B14
emergency_or_help_contact: Gate agent desk / Airport info line +49-30-000-1111

short_description: Main check-in counters for international and domestic flights departing from Terminal 1.
directions: Enter Terminal 1 main hall, check-in counters are directly ahead, organized by airline alliance.
accessibility: Priority check-in lane for reduced-mobility passengers, low-height counters available.
related_facilities: Baggage drop, Ticketing office, Currency exchange

short_description: Central baggage claim hall with carousels 1 to 8 for arriving flights.
directions: Follow 'Baggage Claim' signs after passport control, carousels are numbered and matched to flight number on arrival screens.
accessibility: Wheelchair accessible, baggage trolleys available, lowered carousel viewing area.
related_facilities: Lost and Found, Customs desk, Trolley rental

short_description: Central security screening checkpoint for all departing passengers.
directions: After check-in, follow overhead signs to 'Security Control', multiple lanes including fast-track for premium passengers.
accessibility: Dedicated accessible lane, staff assistance available for passengers with disabilities.
related_facilities: Fast-track lane, Liquids repacking station, Duty free zone beyond security

short_description: General passenger information and wayfinding assistance desk.
directions: Located in the center of the main terminal hall, opposite the check-in counters.
accessibility: Fully wheelchair accessible, hearing loop available, multilingual staff.
related_facilities: Lost and Found, Special Assistance Desk, Currency exchange

short_description: Office for reporting and retrieving lost items and mishandled baggage.
directions: Adjacent to Baggage Claim Hall, next to Carousel 1, clearly signed 'Lost and Found'.
accessibility: Step-free access, counter at wheelchair-accessible height.

short_description: Premium passenger lounge with seating, food, and Wi-Fi, near gates C1-C10.
directions: After security, take escalator to Level 3, lounge entrance is opposite Gate C3.
accessibility: Wheelchair accessible entrance, accessible restrooms inside lounge.
related_facilities: Business center, Shower facilities, Quiet zone

short_description: Quiet multi-faith prayer and reflection room available to all passengers.
directions: Take elevator to Level 1, follow signs to 'Chapel / Prayer Room' near the central corridor.
accessibility: Fully accessible, ablution facilities nearby.

short_description: Food court with multiple restaurants and cafes serving hot meals, snacks, and beverages.
directions: After security, take escalator to Level 2, food court is signposted throughout the departures hall.
accessibility: Fully accessible, seating area with accessible tables.

short_description: Direct underground rail link connecting the airport to the city centre and regional stations.
directions: Follow 'S-Bahn / Train' signs from arrivals hall, take elevator or escalator to basement level.
accessibility: Elevators available, tactile paving, accessible ticket machines.
related_facilities: Taxi zone, Bus stops, Car rental

floor_or_zone: Ground Floor, Exits A and B
short_description: Official taxi rank with metered taxis available 24 hours.
directions: Exit terminal through door A or B, taxi rank is immediately outside with queue management barriers.
accessibility: Accessible taxis available on request from the taxi marshal.

short_description: Dedicated desk for passengers requiring mobility assistance, visual or hearing impairment support.
directions: Located near the main entrance of Terminal 1, clearly signed 'Special Assistance'.
accessibility: Fully accessible, hearing loop, braille information, wheelchair loan available.

short_description: Public restrooms including accessible toilet facilities near the B gates area.
directions: From Gate B12, turn left and follow signs; restrooms are 30m along the corridor.
accessibility: Accessible toilet, baby changing unit, lowered sinks.

short_description: Dedicated family room with baby changing facilities, play area, and nursing station.
directions: After security on Level 2, follow 'Family Services' signs near the central atrium.
accessibility: Fully accessible, stroller parking available.

short_description: Airport pharmacy stocking travel medications, first aid items, and personal care products.
directions: Located on the ground floor near the check-in hall, between check-in zones B and C.
accessibility: Wheelchair accessible, pharmacist available for advice.

floor_or_zone: Ground Floor, near Check-in Zone A
short_description: Bank ATMs and currency exchange machines near the main check-in hall.
directions: Located beside the main information desk on the ground floor of Terminal 1.
accessibility: Accessible height ATMs with audio assistance available.
emergency_or_help_contact: Bank helpline on ATM screen / Security +49-30-000-1114

short_description: Passport control and immigration processing for arriving international passengers.
directions: After disembarking, follow 'Passport Control / Immigration' signs through the arrivals corridor.
accessibility: Dedicated accessible lane, eGate kiosks for eligible passport holders.

short_description: Inter-terminal shuttle bus and hotel shuttle bus stop.
directions: Exit Terminal 1 through Exit C, shuttle bus stops are marked with yellow bus icons on the pavement.
accessibility: Low-floor buses with ramp access.
related_facilities: Taxi Pickup Zone, Car Rental Counter

short_description: Car rental desks for all major rental companies including Hertz, Avis, Sixt and Europcar.
directions: In the arrivals hall, follow signs to 'Car Rental' on the right side past baggage claim.
accessibility: Accessible parking spaces available in car rental garage.

short_description: First aid station and medical assistance point staffed by trained first responders.
directions: Located adjacent to the security control area on the ground floor, clearly marked with a red cross sign.
accessibility: Fully accessible, defibrillator (AED) available, wheelchair access.

short_description: Large duty-free shopping area with perfumes, alcohol, tobacco, cosmetics and luxury goods.
directions: Immediately after passing security control on Level 2, the duty-free zone is directly ahead.
accessibility: Fully wheelchair accessible, wide aisles throughout.
related_facilities: Shopping area, Restaurant Court, Gate area

short_description: Foreign currency exchange and money transfer services available landside and airside.
directions: Landside counter is near the main entrance; airside counter is past security near the food court.
accessibility: Accessible counter height available on request.

floor_or_zone: Level 2, Airside, Gate areas B and C
short_description: Free public device charging stations with USB-A, USB-C and universal power sockets. Charge your phone, laptop or tablet here. Power outlets, USB socket, battery top-up, dead phone, low battery.
directions: Charging pods are located along the seating rows near gates B10-B14 and throughout the departures lounge.
accessibility: Accessible height charging units available.

short_description: Designated outdoor smoking area for passengers before security screening.
directions: Exit Terminal 1 through Exit D on the ground floor, smoking area is 20m to the right with signage.
accessibility: Accessible outdoor area, covered from rain.

short_description: Multi-storey car park with short-stay, long-stay and premium parking options.
directions: Follow 'Parking' signs from the airport access road; pedestrian walkway connects Level P2 to Terminal 1 departures.
accessibility: Dedicated accessible parking bays on Level P1, near lift access.
related_facilities: Taxi Pickup Zone, Shuttle Bus Stop, Car Rental

short_description: Customs declaration and inspection area for arriving international passengers.
directions: After immigration control, follow the green 'Nothing to Declare' or red 'Goods to Declare' channels.
accessibility: Accessible lanes available, staff assistance on request.
related_facilities: Immigration Desk, Baggage Claim Hall, Lost and Found

short_description: Self-service and staffed baggage drop counters for passengers who have completed online check-in.
directions: Adjacent to the check-in counters in Zone B, look for 'Baggage Drop' overhead signage.
accessibility: Low-height drop counters, staff assistance available.
related_facilities: Self Check-in Kiosks, Check-in Area, Baggage Wrapping

floor_or_zone: Ground Floor, Zone A, left end
short_description: Dedicated check-in counter for oversized or heavy luggage such as sports equipment and prams.
directions: At the far left of the check-in Zone A, clearly marked 'Oversized Baggage'.
accessibility: Wide accessible counter, floor-level drop point for heavy items.

floor_or_zone: Ground Floor, near Check-in Zone B
short_description: Professional baggage wrapping service for tamper protection and security.
directions: Located beside the baggage drop zone in Zone B, look for the wrapping machine kiosk.
accessibility: Counter accessible for wheelchair users.
related_facilities: Baggage Drop Zone, Check-in Area, Lost and Found

floor_or_zone: Ground Floor, Zone A and B
short_description: Self-service check-in kiosks for printing boarding passes and bag tags.
directions: Located in front of the main check-in counters in Zones A and B.
accessibility: Accessible kiosks with audio guidance and braille keypads.

short_description: Secure left-luggage lockers and staffed storage facility for short or long term bag storage.
directions: Follow 'Left Luggage / Baggage Storage' signs near the main information desk on the ground floor.
accessibility: Accessible lockers at ground level, staff can assist with heavy items.

short_description: Dedicated desk for transit and connecting flight passengers requiring assistance or rebooking.
directions: After landing, before immigration, follow 'Transfer / Connecting Flights' signs to the transfer desk.
accessibility: Wheelchair accessible counter, fast-track transfer lane for PRM passengers.

short_description: Airside retail shops selling clothing, electronics, books, souvenirs and travel accessories.
directions: After security on Level 2, the shopping area runs alongside the duty-free zone towards the gate piers.
accessibility: Fully accessible, wide retail corridors.

short_description: Supervised children's play zone with soft play equipment, interactive games and seating for parents.
directions: After security, Level 2, follow 'Family Services' or 'Play Area' signs towards Gate B6.
accessibility: Fully accessible, stroller-friendly entry.
related_facilities: Family Room, Restaurant Court, Restroom Block A

short_description: Bookable sleep pods and quiet rest area for passengers with long layovers.
directions: In Terminal 2, take escalator to Level 3, sleep pods are adjacent to the airport lounge.
accessibility: Accessible pod available, lowered entry.
related_facilities: Airport Lounge, Shower Facility, Restaurant Court

short_description: Private shower cubicles available to lounge members and day-pass holders.
directions: Access via the Airport Lounge on Level 3 in Terminal 2; request at the lounge reception desk.
accessibility: Accessible wet room available on request.

short_description: Federal police station handling security incidents, lost documents and emergency response.
directions: Located on the ground floor of Terminal 1, follow 'Police / Bundespolizei' signs near the main entrance.
accessibility: Fully accessible, interpreters available on request.

short_description: Designated pickup area for Uber, Bolt and other ride-hailing services.
directions: Exit Terminal 1 through Exit E, follow the blue 'Ride-Hailing' signs to the designated waiting area.
accessibility: Accessible vehicle options available through respective apps.
related_facilities: Taxi Pickup Zone, Shuttle Bus Stop
